# Section 2 tail filler

832 bytes of 0xff filler inside the section 2 load; OMKit puts its trampoline and loader body here.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x605af4c0` to `0x605af800` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Section 2 loads up to 0x605af800, so the filler is loaded. No literal, branch or constructor table points into it. It is inside the DbgSup protected range, so execute and read only; leave the word at 0x605af4b0 alone.
